title: Project and Skills Management
summary: This module provides decorators for defining project components like agents, tasks, LLMs, and tools, along with utilities for managing and loading skills within a CrewAI project.

nodes.label: Project Annotations
nodes.title: Project Annotations
nodes.description: Defines decorators for marking methods as agents, tasks, LLMs, tools, cache handlers, and kickoff hooks, as well as output formats.

nodes.label: Crew Base Type
nodes.title: Crew Base Type Metaclass
nodes.description: A metaclass that transforms a decorated class into a CrewAI project, enabling the use of project annotations.

nodes.label: Decorated Method Wrappers
nodes.title: Decorated Method Wrappers
nodes.description: Provides a base class for wrapping methods with decorator metadata, preserving callable signatures and attributes.

nodes.label: Skill Resource Loader
nodes.title: Skill Resource Loader
nodes.description: Handles the loading and promotion of skills to a higher disclosure level, making them accessible within the project.

nodes.label: Project Utilities
nodes.title: Project Utilities
nodes.description: Contains utility functions, including a wrapper for memoizing method calls with caching.

groups.label: Project Definition
groups.title: Project Definition
groups.description: Components responsible for defining and structuring CrewAI projects using annotations and metaclasses.

groups.label: Skill Management
groups.title: Skill Management
groups.description: Handles the loading and integration of skills into the CrewAI project.

groups.label: Core Utilities
groups.title: Core Utilities
groups.description: General utility components supporting project functionality, including method wrapping and caching.
